stories.title: Rename app Vyaapar -> MSW Global
stories.accept: Brand reads 'MSW Global' everywhere user-facing.

stories.title: Auto-refresh data lists (no manual reload)
stories.accept: Adding a product shows in POS without hard reload.

stories.title: Party supplier saved as customer
stories.accept: Creating a party as Supplier persists partyType=SUPPLIER.

stories.title: Password strength on staff-create + eye everywhere
stories.accept: Weak staff passwords rejected client-side.

stories.title: Add-category UI for items + expenses
stories.accept: User can create a category from the form.

stories.title: Credit settle: collect payment (unpaid -> paid)
stories.accept: One action records payment and flips toward PAID.

stories.title: Product return button in UI
stories.accept: Authorized user can issue a return; invoice REFUNDED.

stories.title: Payroll all staff/branches + advance/custom salary
stories.accept: One Generate covers every active staff; advance/custom amount.

stories.title: RBAC Super Admin / Manager / Biller scoping + route guards
stories.accept: Biller reaches only POS + today's sales; Manager scoped; Super Admin all.

stories.title: Barcode 2-up print + thermal bill customization
stories.accept: Print 2 barcode slips; thermal header/footer customizable.

stories.title: Signup page: rename CTA to 'Sign Up', visible password rules, no email verification
stories.accept: Primary button reads 'Sign Up' (not 'Start Free Trial'). A visible password-requirements hint is shown and weak passwords are rejected before submit (already enforced by zod + backend @IsStrongPassword). Signup logs the user in immediately with no email-verification step (confirm none exists).

stories.title: Friendly duplicate-SKU / unique-constraint errors (no 500)
stories.accept: Creating an item with an existing Item Code/SKU (unique [businessId,branchId,sku]) returns a clear 409 message like 'An item with this Item Code already exists' instead of HTTP 500 'Internal server error'. Implemented via a global Prisma exception filter that maps P2002/P2025 to friendly 4xx and names the field where possible.

stories.title: Housekeeping & Services keep the Hotel PMS header/tab bar
stories.accept: Clicking Housekeeping (and Services) from the Hotel PMS tab bar keeps the Hotel PMS header + tabs visible (route lives under /hotel/* or shares HotelLayout). Page styling is consistent with the rest of the hotel chrome. The 2 react/no-unescaped-entities lint errors on the housekeeping page are fixed.

stories.title: Replace window.prompt add-category with proper in-app UI
stories.accept: Adding an item category and an expense category uses an in-app input (inline field or dialog), NOT window.prompt/alert. New category is created via POST /categories and auto-selected immediately.

stories.title: Add-item required fields + backend validation
stories.accept: Creating an item requires (client + backend): Name, Category, Sale Price, Cost/Purchase Price, Unit, Opening Stock quantity ('no. of products'), and Barcode. Each missing field shows a clear message; the backend rejects incomplete payloads with a specific message. SKU/Item Code stays optional (auto-generated).

stories.title: Add-party required fields (Name + Phone + Type)
stories.accept: Creating a party requires (client + backend): Name, Phone, and an explicit Party Type (Customer/Supplier/Both, no silent default). Missing fields show a clear message; backend rejects incomplete payloads.

stories.title: Import: CSV support, real result feedback, downloadable template
stories.accept: The Utilities import accepts CSV (and still JSON) for items and parties, shows the backend result (created / skipped / per-row errors) instead of an always-success toast, and offers a 'Download template' with the expected columns. A duplicate SKU during import is reported as a row error, not a silent skip/500.

stories.title: Mobile shop/hotel switcher + mobile menu
stories.accept: On a narrow (mobile) screen a user can switch between shops and reach the Hotel PMS. The shop/entity switcher (currently only in the hidden-lg sidebar) is surfaced on mobile via the top bar or a menu/sheet, along with access to the 'More' nav (Hotel, Payroll, Staff, Settings).

stories.title: Low-stock notifications (make the bell functional)
stories.accept: When a stock-affecting transaction drops an item to at/below its minStock (or to 0), a Notification row is created (and emitted via events.gateway emitNotification) so the top-bar bell shows a low-stock alert. No other notification types needed.

stories.title: Hotel module: item category management (Food/Beverages/etc.)
stories.accept: A hotel user has a place to create and manage item categories for hotel items (Food, Beverages, Snacks, Desserts, Room Service) and can filter items/services by category. Reuses the retail Category backend (branch-scoped) or a hotel-scoped equivalent.

stories.title: RBAC: 3-tier clarity in staff UI (multi-shop Manager deferred)
stories.accept: Staff-create UI presents the three access tiers (Super Admin / Manager / Biller) clearly, with role options grouped by tier and a per-role scope description. DEFERRED: assigning one Manager to MANY shops needs a User→branches schema + BranchScopeGuard + JWT change (single branchId today) — too large/cross-cutting for one minimal-diff iteration; documented in progress.txt.

stories.title: Credit payment proper form (mode, amount, allocation)
stories.accept: The Collect Payment action uses an in-app form (not window.prompt): amount (defaults to full balance, partial allowed), payment mode (Cash/Bank), optional note, and optional per-invoice allocation. Ledger/invoice status updates as before.

stories.title: Return / Refund / Exchange: per-item + history
stories.accept: From a completed sale, an authorized user can return SPECIFIC items/quantities (not just the whole invoice), choose Refund (money back) or Exchange (return + new items), inventory auto-updates, and there is a Returns history view listing credit notes/returns.

stories.title: Customizable label/barcode designer
stories.accept: A label designer lets the user choose which fields print (Item Name, Category, Size, Colour, MRP, Barcode, SKU/Item Code, Batch), and set label width/height, margins, font size, alignment and barcode size, with thermal paper presets. Settings persist and the printed tag reflects them.

stories.title: Payroll: advance ledger auto-deduction + payslip + per-employee history
stories.accept: A salary advance can be recorded against an employee as a tracked balance that AUTO-deducts from future payroll runs until cleared; each payroll line can generate/print a payslip; and a per-employee salary history is viewable.

stories.title: Create Hotel AND Shop entities, kept separate
stories.accept: The entities page lets the user create BOTH a Shop and a Hotel (explicit type choice / separate 'Add Shop' + 'Add Hotel' actions) and lists Shops and Hotels in separate sections. Backend validates Branch.type in {SHOP,HOTEL}. A newly created HOTEL is bootstrapped (cash account, default room categories, hotel expense categories, txn sequences) so it's usable immediately — today only SHOP branches get bootstrapped. Hotels remain reachable via Hotel PMS, shops via the shop switcher.

stories.title: Return by bill number + select specific items (outside POS)
stories.accept: From the Sale Invoices list (which already searches by bill/invoice number), the Return action opens an item picker to return SPECIFIC products (checkboxes) with Refund/Exchange — not a whole-invoice-only refund. Reuses the existing backend partial refund (lineIds) and the POS item-picker (extracted into a shared ReturnDialog also used by the POS Recent Bills panel).

stories.title: Payroll by start/end date range + print payslips for everyone
stories.accept: Payroll generation accepts a START date + END date range (period stored as a 'YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD' string — no migration; the field is free-form). One action prints a payslip for EVERY employee in a run (bulk 'Print all payslips'), reusing the existing per-line payslip layout (base/OT/bonus/deductions/advance/net) with page breaks.

stories.title: Barcode label positional (drag) designer
stories.accept: The label designer lets the user MOVE fields (Item Name, MRP, Sale Price, SKU, Category, Barcode image, Barcode number, Size, Colour) to any position on the label via drag on a scaled preview, with per-field font size, alignment and show/hide. print-tags renders with absolute x/y positioning. Config persists (localStorage) and is backward-compatible with the existing toggle-based config.

stories.title: Thermal receipt format designer (sections/order/show-hide)
stories.accept: The user can customize the thermal bill format: reorder and show/hide sections (shop name, GSTIN, address, header text, item lines, totals breakdown, payments, footer) and set the base font size. generateThermal renders per this config instead of a fully hardcoded template. Config persists in FirmSettings (new receiptLayout JSON column, applied via db push on deploy). Free x/y is intentionally NOT used (single-column receipt).

stories.title: Availability-aware room-number picker at check-in + reservation
stories.accept: The room dropdown on the check-in/reservation form offers only BOOKABLE rooms: for immediate check-in, rooms with status AVAILABLE; for a future reservation, rooms with no overlapping CONFIRMED/CHECKED_IN reservation for the chosen check-in/check-out dates (re-filtering when the dates change). Backend getRooms supports availability filtering (reusing checkOverlappingReservation), so the user never picks a room that gets rejected on submit.

stories.title: Room picker works on DIRECT /hotel/check-in (resolve hotel branch)
stories.accept: Opening /hotel/check-in directly (e.g. via the Hotel PMS 'Check-in' tab, no ?branchId) resolves a HOTEL branch itself — fetch /branches?type=HOTEL, seed selectedBranchId from the query param else auto-select the first hotel (property selector when >1), and gate the rooms query on it — so the room dropdown populates instead of falling back to the user's shop branch (empty).

stories.title: Payment method + bank account at hotel check-out / guest payment
stories.accept: The Record Guest Payment / checkout flow lets the user choose a payment method (Cash/Bank/UPI/Card) and a bank account for non-cash; addFolioPayment threads paymentType + bankAccountId into the txnCore PAYMENT_IN (so it lands in the right cash/bank account) instead of hardcoding CASH. FolioPayment stores the chosen bankAccountId.

stories.title: Separate payroll staff for shops vs hotel (entity selector)
stories.accept: The payroll page has an entity selector (each Shop and Hotel). The staff list, add-staff, and Generate are scoped to the SELECTED entity (explicit branchId), so a hotel's staff and a shop's staff are separate — a new hire lands on the selected entity (incl. hotel), and generating payroll processes only that entity's staff (not business-wide).

stories.title: Fix partial refund (selection UX) + Exchange with replacement-item picker
stories.accept: Partial refund reliably works: the return dialog starts with NO items selected (checked = 'return this item'), so choosing specific items sends lineIds and refunds only those. Exchange lets the user CHOOSE replacement item(s): a replacement picker feeds a backend exchangeInvoice that cash-refunds the returned items AND creates a fully-paid replacement SALE_INVOICE (deterministic backend-computed totals). Inventory updates for both sides.

stories.title: Remove a hotel folio charge / service request
stories.accept: A user can DELETE a hotel folio extra charge (backend DELETE /hotel/reservations/:id/folio/:chargeId that reverses the stock deduction when the charge has an itemId) and a hotel service request (backend DELETE /services/:id), each with a remove button in the UI.

stories.title: P&L includes hotel + services revenue
stories.accept: The Profit & Loss report includes hotel revenue — room revenue + folio/service charges for reservations CHECKED_OUT in the period (reservation.totalAmount + extraCharges) — as a revenue block folded into gross sale / net profit. Today P&L aggregates only SALE_INVOICE so all hotel/service income is invisible; adding it is double-count-safe because P&L currently contains zero hotel data.

stories.title: Fix exchange replacement picker (catalog /items response shape)
stories.accept: In the Return/Exchange dialog, the 'Choose replacements' step lists selectable catalog items so the user can actually pick the exchanged item. Root cause: return-dialog.tsx fetches GET /items as `{ items: CatalogItem[] }` but that endpoint (items.service.ts list()) returns a BARE array Item[] — so `catalog?.items` is undefined and the picker is permanently empty ('won't let choosing the exchanged item'). Fix the fetch to read the array directly. Do NOT change the API shape (items/page.tsx and txn-form.tsx correctly consume the bare array).

stories.title: Allow multiple partial returns per invoice (per-line remaining qty)
stories.accept: refundInvoice no longer rejects every return after the first (current guard `if (txn.returns.length) throw 'already been returned'`). Instead it computes already-returned quantity per line from existing CREDIT_NOTE returns (returnAgainstTxnId) and rejects only a line that has nothing left to return; and the invoice is marked REFUNDED once cumulative returns exhaust all lines (not only on the single full-return path). A user can return one item now and another item later. Over-returning a fully-returned line is rejected.

stories.title: Hotel: settle outstanding balance at check-out (backend)
stories.accept: POST /hotel/check-out/:id accepts an optional settlement body { method, amount, bankAccountId?, reference? }. When amount>0, checkOut records a FolioPayment, increments reservation.paidAmount, and posts exactly one PAYMENT_IN txn (paymentType=method, bankAccountId for non-cash) so cash/bank balances move — reusing the same accounting path as addFolioPayment (factor a shared private helper). No body / amount=0 behaves exactly as today (backward compatible). CHECKED_OUT / room CLEANING / housekeeping-task transitions unchanged. No SALE txn is created (no double count).

stories.title: Hotel: payment method + bank picker on Complete Checkout (frontend)
stories.accept: The checkout dialog's Complete Checkout action shows a payment-method selector (Cash/Bank/UPI/Card) and, for non-cash, a bank-account dropdown (reusing bankAccounts query + newPaymentMethod/newPaymentBankId state), pre-filled to settle summary.pendingDues. checkoutMutation POSTs { method, amount, bankAccountId } when pendingDues>0 so the final balance is settled with the chosen method at checkout. Non-cash without a bank account is blocked client-side. Zero-dues checkout works with no method selection.

stories.title: Hotel dashboard/report: billed revenue + profit + services (not folio-payments-only)
stories.accept: hotelReport() bases totalRevenue/today/month/year on BILLED reservation revenue (totalAmount + extraCharges for CHECKED_OUT, bucketed by checkedOutAt) — matching the R37 P&L — instead of folio-payments-only, so a hotel that checks guests in/out but never records a folio payment still shows non-zero revenue/profit on /hotel/dashboard and /reports/hotel. Keep folio-payment collections exposed as a distinct `collected` metric. Include a serviceRevenue figure (COMPLETED serviceRequest amounts in period, informational — not double-added since checked-out service money is already in extraCharges). Also broaden services.create() reservation linking to include CONFIRMED (not only CHECKED_IN) so in-stay/upcoming services aren't orphaned. Shop home dashboard stays shop-only (shop/hotel kept separate).

stories.title: Reconcile balance sheet after hotel revenue enters net profit (R37 side-effect)
stories.accept: balanceSheet() balances (assets == liabilities + equity within rounding) even though equity's retained earnings now include hotel revenue (R37). Add a hotel dues receivable asset = sum over CHECKED_OUT reservations of max(0, totalAmount + extraCharges - paidAmount), so accrued-but-uncollected hotel revenue is represented on the asset side matching the retained-earnings it produced. Collected hotel revenue is already reflected in cash/bank via PAYMENT_IN txns.

stories.title: /reports/hotel (+pnl/balance-sheet/trial-balance) honor ?branchId query
stories.accept: The hotel report endpoint reads branchId from @Query('branchId') falling back to @CurrentUser('branchId'), like every /hotel/* endpoint. ROOT CAUSE of 'hotel revenue shows zero everywhere': the hotel dashboard requests /reports/hotel?branchId=<hotel> but the controller only read the resolved x-branch-id header (global active SHOP), so hotelReport was scoped to a non-hotel branch => 0 rooms/reservations/revenue. Apply the same to pnl/trial-balance/balance-sheet controllers so hotel numbers scope correctly.

stories.title: Hotel dashboard passes branchId to api() + real-time refetch; drop dead invalidations
stories.accept: hotel/dashboard passes { branchId: selectedBranchId } as an api() option (so x-branch-id header targets the hotel branch; api.ts never derives it from the query string) for /reports/hotel, revenue-metrics and reservations; uses refetchOnMount:'always' and a modest refetchInterval so KPIs are near real-time. hotel/page.tsx removes the dead ['hotel-profit'] invalidations and also invalidates ['dashboard'] and ['report'] after checkout/payment/cancel so Home + reports refresh without a manual reload.

stories.title: expenses.create injects resolved branchId so hotel expenses count in profit
stories.accept: When an expense is created without an explicit branchId, the resolved branchId (CurrentUser branchId) is set so hotel-branch expenses aren't saved null. Today null-branch hotel expenses are excluded from hotelReport.expensesIn and branch-scoped P&L, understating hotel cost/profit. Existing explicit-branch callers unchanged.

stories.title: Home dashboard includes a hotel revenue block
stories.accept: reports.dashboard() returns monthHotelRevenue/todayHotelRevenue (billed: CHECKED_OUT reservations' totalAmount+extraCharges bucketed by checkedOutAt, branch-scoped) and folds hotel revenue into netRevenue; the Home dashboard shows a Hotel Revenue figure. Double-count-safe: PAYMENT_IN folio txns are NOT counted as sales. Shop-only businesses see zero hotel (no behavior change).

stories.title: [schema] TxnLine.sourceLineId self-link + thread through txn-core
stories.accept: Add nullable TxnLine.sourceLineId (@map source_line_id) with self-relation (sourceLine/returnLines) + @@index; additive, db push safe, legacy rows null. TxnLineInput gains sourceLineId?; buildLines copies it into the created line; applyStock/computeTotals unchanged (they key off per-line quantity, so a reduced qty yields correct stock + totals). prisma generate succeeds; typecheck green.

stories.title: [backend] refundInvoice partial-quantity + exact over-return cap; exchange forwards returns
stories.accept: refundInvoice accepts returns:[{lineId,quantity}] (lineIds still accepted => full remaining qty). alreadyReturned per line computed EXACTLY by summing prior credit-note line quantities grouped by sourceLineId (signature fallback for legacy null rows). Reject quantity<=0 or quantity>(purchased-alreadyReturned) with a clear message. Credit-note lines built with the RETURNED quantity + sourceLineId; flat line discount prorated (discountAmount*qty/origQty) or discountPercent passed through; refund=floor2(sum recomputed returned-line totals) so it never exceeds createTxn total. Mark REFUNDED only when every line fully returned. exchangeInvoice forwards returns into refundInvoice. Stock restored for returned qty only (CREDIT_NOTE inverts). Two identical item+price lines capped independently.

stories.title: [backend] getTxn exposes per-line purchased + already-returned qty
stories.accept: getTxn returns, per invoice line, the already-returned quantity (via returns.include lines.select sourceLineId/quantity, or a computed returnedQty map) so the return dialog can cap each picker at purchased-returned. Additive to the shared payload; no renamed fields; typecheck green.

stories.title: [frontend] Per-line return quantity picker (return N of M)
stories.accept: Return dialog replaces the whole-line checkbox with a per-line quantity input (default 0) capped at remaining = purchased - alreadyReturned (from getTxn), plus a 'return all remaining' quick action. returnedTotal computed from unitPrice*qty*(1+tax/100) discount-prorated. Refund body { mode:'REFUND', returns:[{lineId,quantity}] } (rows with qty>0); exchange body { returns, replacements }. Submit disabled when nothing selected or any qty exceeds max. Buying 2 and returning 1 works end to end (stock +1, refund for 1).

stories.title: [schema] Item.size + persistence/search/filter in items service
stories.accept: Add nullable Item.size (@map size) + @@index([businessId,size]); additive, db push safe. ItemInput gains size?; create/update persist trimmed size (null when blank); list() adds size to the search OR-clause and an optional exact ?size= filter; posCatalog rows carry size automatically. prisma generate + typecheck green.

stories.title: [frontend] Size in Add/Edit Item form, inventory list/detail, and filter
stories.accept: Add Item form has a Size field (dropdown presets S/M/L/XL/32/34/36 with free-text) for PRODUCT items; size saved on create/edit; a SIZE column in the items list and size shown in the detail panel; an optional size filter narrows the list. Item TS interface + ItemForm + EMPTY_FORM + save/edit maps updated.

stories.title: [frontend] Size shown in billing item picker + POS catalog (prints on bill)
stories.accept: Billing item picker (txn-form) and POS catalog display the item size and match it in search/filter; the chosen size is folded into the stored line name so it prints on the bill (TxnLine.name is denormalized; no line schema change). PosProduct type/cache/map/filter include size so offline rows carry it. typecheck green.

stories.title: [backend] Hotel checkout accepts split payments array; include folioPayments in details
stories.accept: check-out/:id body widened to accept optional payments:[{method,amount,bankAccountId?,reference?}] (single {method,amount,bankAccountId} still works). checkOut normalizes to a list, validates each non-cash entry has a bankAccountId and that sum(amounts) doesn't exceed pending, writes one FolioPayment row per entry (paidAmount incremented by the total) inside the transaction, and after commit posts ONE PAYMENT_IN whose payments[] has one element per entry (txnCore enforces sum===total). 'Bank Transfer' maps to paymentType 'BANK'. getReservationWithDetails includes folioPayments so the invoice/print can show 'Paid via'. cashFlow then surfaces each method separately with no reports change.

stories.title: [frontend] Split-payment checkout UI + 'Paid via' on invoice + Bank Transfer label
stories.accept: Checkout dialog offers Single | Split mode. Split lets staff add/remove rows {method,amount,bankAccountId?}; per-row method select (Cash/Card/UPI/Bank Transfer) + conditional bank picker; live 'remaining = pendingDues - sum(rows)'; checkout enabled only when the rows sum to pendingDues. Submits settle { payments: rows }. Single-mode 'Bank' relabeled 'Bank Transfer' (maps to BANK). The Print Bill shows a 'Paid via: <method> <amount>' block from the reservation's folioPayments. Reports show each method as its own cash-flow line.

stories.title: Barcode label designer: bigger workspace + zoom, resize handles, add/remove custom text, alignment
stories.accept: The label designer has a much larger, zoomable workspace; every element is drag-to-move AND has a drag resize handle (font size for text, height/width for the barcode); users can add and remove their own free-text elements and set per-element alignment. Config schema gains align + custom[] + barcodeWidthMm (localStorage, back-compat normalized). print-tags renders alignment, custom text, and barcode width.

stories.title: Bill/thermal designer: larger visual canvas, drag-reorder, per-section font/align/show, add/remove custom lines
stories.accept: The thermal bill editor becomes a larger visual designer: drag to reorder sections, per-section font size + alignment + show/hide, and add/remove custom text lines (header/footer notes). receiptLayout (Json) extended with per-section font/align + custom lines; receipts.service.generateThermal renders them; back-compat with the old {fontPx, sections} shape.

stories.title: Hotel checkout dialog: fixed header/scroll body/sticky footer so checkout button is always visible
stories.accept: The checkout/folio dialog no longer overflows the viewport: DialogContent is a flex column capped at 90vh; the folio/guest/payment content scrolls in the middle; the Print Bill + Settle/Complete Checkout actions live in a fixed footer that stays visible without scrolling.

stories.title: Barcode label designer: desktop two-column layout so right-side controls/buttons aren't crushed
stories.accept: On desktop the designer goes side-by-side at lg (not xl); the preview column flexes/shrinks while the controls column keeps a fixed comfortable width (360-400px), so the action/button groups stay aligned horizontally with proper spacing instead of stacking cramped.

stories.title: #1 Strong password policy (upper+lower+digit+special, >=8) with clear message
stories.accept: Shared PASSWORD_COMPLEXITY_REGEX requires lowercase+uppercase+digit+special char (min 8); message names all four classes. Signup client (zod) + server (@IsStrongPassword) reject weak passwords before account creation. Login unaffected (existing users not locked out).

stories.title: #4 Show discount % AND rupee amount in invoice totals
stories.accept: txn-form totals compute+show aggregate Item Discount rupees and the Bill Discount % now shows '= -₹Y' computed live from the percentage, visible in the summary before Total.

stories.title: #5 PDF header: constrain business name width to stop white-on-red overlap
stories.accept: PDF business-name text is width-constrained (320, no wrap, ellipsis) so a long name can't overrun into the right-aligned document label or wrap onto the address.

stories.title: #6 Restore Recent Bills button visibility in POS
stories.accept: Recent Bills trigger restyled (secondary, brand-red text on white, h-9) so it's visible in the red POS bar instead of white-on-white, and fits next to Hold.

stories.title: #7 Hotel print CSS: printout shows only the folio, not chrome/buttons
stories.accept: Checkout footer is print:hidden and a global @media print block hides the app shell (aside/header/nav), un-fixes the dialog, and hides entry forms — so window.print() prints only the bill, no 'Print Bill'/checkout buttons. POS thermal (separate window) unaffected.

stories.title: #8 Hotel check-in uses room custom price over category default; manual rate preserved
stories.accept: Rooms query returns price; preselect/onChange/submit seed roomRate from room.price ?? category.basePrice; a manually typed rate is used on submit (form.roomRate wins) and isn't clobbered. Dropdown shows the effective per-room price.

stories.title: Label/thermal print: wait for images + safety timeout (fix 'sometimes nothing prints')
stories.accept: printHtmlDocument injects a trigger that waits for all images (barcode) to load before print(), auto-closes on afterprint, and prints anyway after a 1.5s safety timeout. Replaces the racy w.onload=print assigned after document.close.

stories.title: Label print rotation option (fix 'prints horizontally')
stories.accept: LabelConfig gains rotateDeg (0/90/180/270, normalized, back-compat); print-tags swaps @page dims + rotates content into a .page wrapper for 90/270; designer has a 'Print rotation' control so users match the TVS roll feed without editing the driver.

stories.title: Sync banner: server reachability is source of truth (not navigator.onLine)
stories.accept: Banner always pings checkApiHealth (/health/ready) and derives online from it; navigator online/offline events only trigger a re-check. Fixes 'shows Offline even when online'. Hidden when reachable + nothing pending.

stories.title: Sync manager: flush on reachability, never silently drop rows
stories.accept: processSyncQueue gates on checkApiHealth (not navigator.onLine), pushes ALL queued rows when reachable, keeps rows queued on failure (bumps attempts for diagnostics only). getPendingSyncCount counts all rows so nothing disappears from the pending count. Fixes stuck 'Ready to Sync'.

stories.title: #3 Auto-generate unique barcode on item create; validate uniqueness on edit
stories.accept: Item create auto-generates a unique barcode from product details when none supplied (generateUniqueBarcode retries a perturbed prefix, keeps cost suffix); supplied barcode validated unique (ConflictException). update() rejects a barcode used by another item (empty clears to null). assignBarcode retries-until-unique. Uniqueness enforced in application code (no DB migration, so prisma db push deploy stays safe).

stories.title: #3 Web items form: barcode optional (auto-generated)
stories.accept: Add Item no longer requires a barcode; the field is labeled 'auto-generated if left blank' and stays editable for a unique override.

stories.title: Login rejects disabled (isActive:false) users
stories.accept: login() rejects users with isActive:false ('This account has been disabled') so a disabled user cannot mint fresh tokens.

stories.title: #2 Forgot-password via role key (no email/OTP), fail-closed
stories.accept: resetPassword(email, roleKey, newPassword) verifies the account by email + the role-specific key from env (resetKeyForRole -> SUPER_ADMIN_RESET_KEY/ADMIN_RESET_KEY/BILLER_RESET_KEY). Fails closed (generic UnauthorizedException) on unknown email, unconfigured key, or mismatch — no OTP, no account enumeration, no bypass. New password must meet policy. Sessions invalidated.

stories.title: #2 Web forgot-password single-step role-key form
stories.accept: One form: email + reset key + new password (client policy precheck) -> POST /auth/reset-password {email, roleKey, newPassword}. No OTP step/copy.

stories.title: #10 Authenticated change-password endpoint
stories.accept: POST /auth/change-password (JWT-guarded) bcrypt-compares currentPassword then hashes newPassword (policy-checked); invalidates sessions.

stories.title: #10 Web change-password page + settings nav card
stories.accept: Settings has a Change Password card -> /settings/account with current + new + confirm inputs, client policy precheck, POST /auth/change-password.

stories.title: RBAC: relabel roles + add BILLER_HOTEL + split SALES_REPORTS_VIEW (no migration)
stories.accept: No role-string migration. ADMIN=Super Admin (full, business owner), BRANCH_MANAGER=Admin (full shop/hotel ops, NO payroll/BUSINESS_MANAGE => branch-locked), BILLER=Biller(Shop) (POS+returns+SALES_REPORTS_VIEW), new BILLER_HOTEL=Biller(Hotel) (hotel ops only). Added SALES_REPORTS_VIEW permission (sales reports) distinct from REPORTS_VIEW (financial); granted to owners/admin/accountant/biller-shop.

stories.title: Re-gate reports: sales endpoints on SALES_REPORTS_VIEW (override class financial gate)
stories.accept: reports /sale and /day-book use method-level SALES_REPORTS_VIEW (overrides class REPORTS_VIEW via getAllAndOverride), so Biller(Shop) reaches daily/weekly/monthly sales reports but not P&L/balance-sheet/cash-flow/GST (still REPORTS_VIEW).

stories.title: #11 User-management endpoints: update / disable / soft-delete
stories.accept: PATCH /users/:id (name/role/branch), PATCH /users/:id/status (isActive), DELETE /users/:id (soft delete). All USER_MANAGE, same-business scoped; owners (BUSINESS_MANAGE)/super-admin not modifiable; cannot disable/delete self. Role changes restricted to STAFF_ASSIGNABLE_ROLES. Disable/delete effective next request (jwt.strategy re-checks isActive/deletedAt).

stories.title: #11 Web user-management row actions + new roles
stories.accept: User rows show DISABLED badge + Disable/Enable + Remove buttons (hidden for self); role picker offers Admin / Biller (Shop) / Biller (Hotel) + hotel staff with updated descriptions; password message uses the new policy.

stories.title: Web confinement: Biller(Shop)->pos+reports+sale, Biller(Hotel)->hotel; Reports nav on SALES_REPORTS_VIEW
stories.accept: layout redirect: Biller(Shop) confined to /pos+/reports+/sale, Biller(Hotel) confined to /hotel. Sidebar Reports entry gated by SALES_REPORTS_VIEW so Biller(Shop) can open sales reports (financial reports still 403 server-side).

stories.title: #9 Sales/Purchase list table scrolls (no page horizontal scroll)
stories.accept: txn list table wrapped in overflow-x-auto with min-w-[720px] so wide columns scroll inside the card instead of overflowing the page on mobile.

stories.title: #9 Items page two-pane stacks on mobile + table scrolls
stories.accept: Items root flex-col lg:flex-row; left pane w-full lg:w-80; All Items table wrapped in overflow-x-auto (min-w) instead of a clipping overflow-hidden card, so mobile shows a stacked layout without cut-off.

stories.title: #9 Item add/edit/adjust dialog grids stack on phones
stories.accept: Dialog form grids grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 so fields stack on phones.

stories.title: Super Admin approval gate for Admin/Biller accounts (+ disable email verification)
stories.accept: User.isApproved Boolean @default(true) (grandfathers all existing users + owners; new staff created isApproved:false = PENDING). Every token-minting path (login, verifyOtp, refresh) rejects unapproved/disabled/locked/suspended via shared assertLoginAllowed; jwt.strategy where-clause requires isApproved:true so tokens for pending users are rejected on every request. Super-Admin-only approve endpoint PATCH /users/:id/approve gated BUSINESS_MANAGE (shop admins forbidden), same-business scoped. Web: PENDING APPROVAL badge + Approve button (owner only) + create note. Email verification already disabled (signup logs in immediately; forgot-password uses role keys). Adversarially verified: no lockout, no bypass, correct authorization.
